title: TransitionReceiptBody
description: Fields a CanonicalReceipt MUST carry when the invoked ability has class=Transition. Fields ride inside the existing receipt body — RFC-003 v1 wire format and envelope are unchanged. Query and Stream abilities MUST NOT emit a body containing these fields (TR-INV-5).

transition_id.description: Stable identifier for the transition. MUST be identical across deployments and SDKs (TR-INV-7). Convention: dotted ability name, e.g. 'media.call.join'.

transition_name.description: Optional human-readable alias. MAY differ from transition_id; MUST NOT be used for routing or verification (TR-INV-7).

attempt_id.description: Globally-unique identifier for this attempt. Retries MUST mint a fresh attempt_id; reuse is forbidden (TR-INV-10). Format: UUIDv4 or ULID.

state_type.description: The typed state object this transition acts on. Same value as the descriptor's state_type field (TR-INV-1). Convention: dotted, e.g. 'media.call'.

state_key.description: Canonicalized string identifying the specific state object instance (TR-INV-8). Resolved from the descriptor's state_key_arg by reading that named field from the invocation args.

pre_state_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical-encoded state object as observed BEFORE the transition. Format: 'sha256:<hex>'. For chain-linkage rule see TR-INV-4.

post_state_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical-encoded state object as it exists AFTER the transition was applied. Format: 'sha256:<hex>'.

pre_state_version.description: Monotonic version of the state object as observed before the transition. Per (state_type, state_key). Verified atomically against current store value (TR-INV-9 / SV-INV-1).

post_state_version.description: Monotonic version after the transition. MUST equal pre_state_version + 1 on success (TR-INV-9). Failed transitions MUST NOT emit a transition receipt at all.

state_version.description: Convenience alias equal to post_state_version. Provided so downstream readers do not have to pick between pre/post when they want 'current'.

$comment: Constraint state_version == post_state_version is enforced by the implementation, not by JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12 cannot express equality between sibling fields without $data, which is non-standard). The implementation MUST reject receipts where these two values differ.
